target_rules.ambiguous_competition: the target is sampled below the top of the latent shortlist when possible
target_rules.base: the target satisfies every required skill at level 2+ and has availability > 0
target_rules.high_load: the target is not one of the five permanently high-load employees
target_rules.incomplete_data: the target may have no rate or no workload records; unknown load is neutral
target_rules.no_suitable_candidate: no target is assigned; no employee has all required skills at level 2+
target_rules.no_suitable_metrics: tasks without a target are excluded from Top-1/Top-3/MRR/NDCG
target_rules.target_selection: qualified candidates are ranked by a hidden latent preference (skills, domain, availability, quality, cost) plus noise; the target is sampled from the top-5, not forced to be the rule top-1

unknown_workload_policy: neutral 0.5 in the experiment rule baseline
